purpose: The operator-side regression battery: every verification the machine gate cannot make — live site behavior, real browsers, real userscript managers, real network endpoints. The machine certifies this manifest is well-formed and aimed at living code (anchor liveness, version stamps, residual coverage); the OPERATOR certifies the code works by running the checklist in documentation/operator-battery/README.md and pasting the report back. BLOCKED is a first-class state (network/ToS/transient conditions) — honest states, never silent.

conventions.install: Install dist/ files via the raw-GitHub URLs in inventory.json (https://github.com/4ndr0666/userscripts/raw/refs/heads/main/dist/<name>.user.js).
conventions.consolePrefixes: Forums++ machinery logs as '[Forums++]' (console.debug/warn); Hailuo++ as '[4ndr0tools][INFO|WARN|DEBUG|ERROR]'; CB as plain '[4ndr0tools]' lines; Instagram++ as '[ARES-9 V7.0]'.
conventions.evidence: Every test: screenshot of the observable + console excerpt (filtered on the prefix above) + manager/browser versions + the URL visited.
conventions.blocked: A thread without the host under test at hand is BLOCKED, not FAIL. Transient site states (maintenance, CF interstitials absent) are BLOCKED with a note.
conventions.rollback: Immediate mitigation is disable-the-toggle or revert-pin the dist file: git checkout <prior-round-tip> -- dist/… (round tips: r7 6c1b7ea, r8 9a18c04, r9 = this round's pin).
